    S

    sameFields(ImmutableList, ImmutableList) - Static method in class network.ike.foundation.ike.writer.StoreWriter
    Whether two field lists say the same thing: trees by structure, meaning, and properties with no regard to child order; components by nid; lists of nids in order; everything else by equality.
    semantic(PublicId, PatternFacade, long, ImmutableList) - Method in class network.ike.foundation.ike.writer.StoreWriter
    Writes a semantic, version-aware: nothing when the latest version says the same, a new version when it differs, a new semantic when none exists.
    statedParent(PublicId, PublicId) - Method in class network.ike.foundation.ike.writer.StoreWriter
    States a concept's parent: its stated-axiom semantic says it is necessarily a kind of the parent, and nothing more.
    StoreWriter - Class in network.ike.foundation.ike.writer
    Writes knowledge into the running store from code, the way the ledger does at replay: one stamp for everything written, concepts with their stated parents, semantics that are version-aware, descriptions with their dialects, and retirement.
    StoreWriter(StampCalculator, Stamp) - Constructor for class network.ike.foundation.ike.writer.StoreWriter
